column1: # ESP32-S3 partition table for galdr (DOC-04 settings persistence).
# espflash applies this when flashing (see espflash.toml). The `storage` partition is the dedicated NVS
# region the settings subsystem uses; its offset/size MUST match `NVS_OFFSET`/`NVS_SIZE` in src/storage.rs.
# Offsets and sizes are sector-aligned (4 KiB). The factory app gets 3 MiB starting at 0x10000
# settings region sits above it at 0x320000 (fits parts >= 4 MiB; S3 devkits are typically 8-16 MiB).
